cases.title: Bakery uses precise typography and buries an extra

expected_items.anchor: send the print-ready PDF of the “Baker’s Picks” menu
expected_items.label: included
expected_items.clause_anchor: Supply the approved “Baker’s Picks” menu as a print-ready PDF – with embedded fonts.
expected_items.rationale: The exact typographic title and print PDF are expressly promised; the quote must preserve curly punctuation and the en dash.

expected_items.label: extra_work
expected_items.rationale: The additional voucher is a new excluded deliverable, despite appearing deep in a chatty message.

input.brief:
Client: Bramble Wink Bakery; contact robin@example.com.
Design one A4 “Baker’s Picks” counter menu – front only.
Supply the approved “Baker’s Picks” menu as a print-ready PDF – with embedded fonts.
Use the supplied copy and the client’s existing colour palette.
Two revision rounds cover text and colour corrections.
First proof is due 24 October; final files are due 30 October.
Out of scope: packaging, gift vouchers and additional menu layouts.
input.message: Hi Pip, hope your week has been a good one and that the rain has finally stopped where you are. The team had a long chat after closing, and everyone enjoyed seeing the little sketches alongside the pastries. There was a lot of discussion about which bun should go at the top, but we agreed the order in the supplied copy can stay. Could you send the print-ready PDF of the “Baker’s Picks” menu as promised? I am collecting the files for our printer before the weekend rush, and they have been very patient with us. Between that and the flour delivery, I almost forgot: please design a double-sided gift voucher as well. We can get you the voucher wording on Monday, so there is no need to guess it. Thanks again for keeping all these bits organised, Robin, robin@example.com.
